If preprod does not serve OHLC, they will now FAIL instead of skipping and test-preprod will go red on the next deploy. That is the intended behaviour, but it wants an operator watching the next run.

notable_findings: deploy-prod is if: false (deploy.yml:1895, 'TEMP: Skip production'), as are build-sse-image-prod and build-dashboard-image-prod. The consequence chain the stow described -- advisory gate, then ready_for_production: true, then prod -- is currently severed at the last hop. The gate still lied and preprod still received unvalidated deploys; only the blast radius had shrunk, and it restores itself the moment prod is re-enabled.

CORRECTION to the stowed record, measured: D2's listener-registration defect is a 4-9ms race, not the certain miss the stow claims. Over 6 samples the search request reaches the network at 33-61ms while fill() returns at 38-69ms. A probe of the OLD ordering did observe the 429 when the response came back slower than the window. The fix still stands -- it closes the window outright at no cost -- but the mechanism is probabilistic, not deterministic.

CORRECTION, measured: anchoring the accessible name does NOT disambiguate AAPL from AAPLW. The symbol and company spans (ticker-input.tsx:215-217) are adjacent with no whitespace text node, so Chromium computes the option name as 'AAPLApple Inc.' and /^AAPL\b/i matches ZERO options. A first pass at this card used exactly that anchor and would have silently broken all 11 locators in sanity.spec.ts -- the suite the gate runs and which has never executed, so nothing would have caught it. Rows are matched by their own id="ticker-option-<symbol>" instead. This is worth carrying forward: any future work tempted to anchor these locators by name will hit the same trap.
The refuters' wider failure-hiding census is untouched and still accurate as far as spot-checked: deploy.yml's summary job (now :2185) is if: always() and only echoes, never exits non-zero.
